title: LLaDA MoE v2: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Language Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.03457v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an alternative to autoregressive (AR) language modeling, yet the scaling behavior of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) dLLMs remains poorly understood. We systematically characterize how optimization hyperparameters, compute allocation, and architecture scale for MoE dLLMs, identifying quantitative differences from scaling trends previously reported for AR models. Specifically, for optimization, the optimal nominal batch size grows faster, while the optimal learning rate decays more rapidly with compute. For model--data allocation, IsoFLOP analysis reveals a slight data-side tilt: the optimal token budget grows faster than activated model-side computation. For MoE architecture, larger scales increasingly favor larger expert pools at fixed activated capacity, while moderate expert granularity remains consistently effective and the preferred fraction of activated capacity assigned to shared experts remains st
reason_zh: 系统研究MoE扩散语言模型的扩展行为，发布v2版本，对模型设计有指导意义。
summary_zh: 扩散语言模型是自回归建模的替代方案，但MoE扩散语言模型的扩展行为尚不清楚。本文系统表征优化超参数、计算分配和架构规模对MoE dLLM的影响，识别与自回归模型扩展的定量差异。基于此发布LLaDA MoE v2，展示改进的性能和效率。

title: AI智能体的记忆，终于有人认真研究“文件系统”这条路了——新论文给出五个反直觉答案
raw_text: 工业界的Agent记忆实践早已收敛到“文件系统”——一棵由Agent自己用通用文件工具读写、重组的Markdown目录树，但学术界大多在设计各种“专用记忆表征”，很少有人认真研究这个已经被广泛部署的默认方案。论文作者把filesystem-based memory形式化为围绕一个共享存储的三种角色：负责写入与整理的管理Agent、负责带引用作答的搜索Agent，以及在技能场景下提供任务轨迹的执行Agent。他们在长对话问答基准（LoCoMo、PersonaMem、REALTALK）和具身任务基准（ALFWorld）上，系统对比了六种记忆形态、不同工具集、不同规模的记忆流，以及不同能力档位的模型，围绕五个研究问题给出了迄今为止最系统的实证画像。
reason_zh: 系统研究Agent记忆的文件系统方案，给出五个反直觉答案，对工程实践有重要指导意义。
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一篇关于AI智能体记忆的论文，该论文聚焦于工业界广泛使用的文件系统记忆方案，而学术界对此研究甚少。论文将文件系统记忆形式化为管理Agent、搜索Agent和执行Agent三种角色，并在多个基准上系统对比了六种记忆形态、工具集、记忆流规模和模型能力。研究围绕五个问题给出了实证答案，揭示了文件系统记忆的有效性和设计取舍，为Agent记忆系统的构建提供了重要参考。
title_zh: AI智能体记忆的文件系统之路：五个反直觉答案

title: New release of LLM adds support for reasoning traces, OpenAI Responses, server-side tools, and smarter logging
raw_text:
I released LLM 0.32 this morning, the most significant new version of LLM since the initial launch of the project. The new version includes support for visible reasoning traces, server-side provider tools, redesigned content-addressable SQLite logs, new models, and new features enabled by the OpenAI Responses API. I also released a new version of the llm-anthropic plugin with substantial updates of its own.

Headline features for LLM CLI users

Running LLM against reasoning models now displays their reasoning traces to standard error, so you can see what they are "thinking" without that information being included in the standard output that you might pipe to another tool. Add -R/--hide-reasoning to turn this off.
reason_zh: 作者亲述LLM 0.32重大更新，涵盖推理痕迹、OpenAI Responses等新特性，对开发者实用性强。
summary_zh: LLM 0.32是该项目自发布以来最重要的版本更新。新版本增加了对可见推理痕迹的支持，允许用户查看模型的思考过程；集成了OpenAI Responses API，支持服务器端工具调用；重新设计了基于内容寻址的SQLite日志系统，提升了日志的可靠性和可查询性。此外，还引入了新模型和多项功能改进。作者Simon Willison在博客中详细介绍了这些新特性及其背后的设计考量，为开发者提供了实用的升级指南。
title_zh: LLM 0.32发布：支持推理痕迹、OpenAI Responses、服务器端工具及更智能日志

title: The Agent Operating System (AOS): A Reference Operating Architecture for Distributed Agentic Systems
raw_text:

Abstract: Large language models have transformed artificial intelligence from isolated prediction services into components of long-running, distributed systems that reason, invoke tools, retrieve external state, delegate tasks, and act on behalf of users and organizations. The surrounding ecosystem has responded with agent frameworks, workflow engines, model-serving platforms, memory systems, communication protocols, and observability tools. These technologies improve execution, but they do not provide a stable, implementation-independent operating architecture for governing intent, selecting capabilities, preserving authority across delegation, controlling uncertainty, coordinating runtime behavior, and reconstructing why consequential actions occurred. reason_zh: 提出经验驱动的自适应引导，提升智能体工具使用的鲁棒性，实用性强。
summary_zh: 智能体的性能瓶颈正从模型能力转向执行过程的鲁棒性。工具作为智能体与外部环境交互的主要接口，现有方法很少关注在不同运行条件下确保工具使用的鲁棒性。本文提出经验驱动的自适应引导方法，通过积累经验动态调整引导策略，增强智能体在多样环境中的工具使用稳定性。

title: LeanMem: Simple and Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.03463v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Long-term memory is essential for LLM-based agents to sustain interactions and reliably leverage distant history. However, existing memory systems typically process heterogeneous dialogue content through a uniform summarization and retrieval pipeline, leading to either excessive token consumption or irreversible loss of fine-grained evidence. We argue that historical dialogue content should be handled differently according to its compressibility, temporal dynamics, and fidelity requirements. Based on this insight, we propose LeanMem, a lightweight long-term memory framework. LeanMem first filters out low-value content, then stores informative segments as compact profile memory, temporally structured event memory, or source-grounded record memory, depending on the nature of the information. During maintenance, only dynamically evolving event memories are selectively updated, avoiding redundant consolidation of stable profiles and immutabl
reason_zh: 提出简单高效的长时记忆方法LeanMem，解决token消耗和证据丢失问题，实用。
summary_zh: 长时记忆对LLM智能体维持交互和利用遥远历史至关重要。现有记忆系统通常通过统一摘要和检索流程处理异构对话内容，导致token消耗过多或细粒度证据不可逆丢失。本文提出LeanMem，通过区分内容类型和自适应处理，实现简单高效的长时记忆，平衡token效率与信息保留。
title_zh: LeanMem：简单高效的LLM智能体长时记忆

title: Anthropic 首次确认自研 AI 芯片：专为 Claude 定制，公司正在组建团队
raw_text:
IT之家 8 月 5 日消息，Anthropic 发言人对 Business Insider 确认，公司正在组建内部芯片团队，计划为旗下 Claude 模型开发定制化芯片，以应对不断增长的 AI 算力需求。这是该公司首次公开确认自研芯片计划。

该发言人表示，Anthropic 计划通过硬件与模型协同设计的方式，让 Claude 能够以更高速度和更高效率运行，并满足客户规模化使用需求。不过，Anthropic 不会完全依赖自研芯片，公司未来将采用“多芯片策略”，继续使用来自 AWS、谷歌、英伟达和 AMD 的硬件。

此前，路透社曾报道称 Anthropic 正在探索自主设计 AI 芯片的可能性。《The Information》上月报道称，Anthropic 已与三星电子就潜在芯片制造合作进行沟通。

Anthropic 最近发布的一份招聘信息进一步透露了该公司的芯片规划。招聘岗位显示，公司正在寻找加入“定制芯片团队”的工程师，候选人需要具备半导体设计、验证等多个领域的专业经验。

该职位提供的年薪范围为 32 万美元至 48.5 万美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 216.4 万元至 328 万元人民币），招聘要求中提到，候选人需要证明自己曾“直接参与”半导体设计最终定型以及产品交付流程。

招聘信息写道：“该岗位适合那些拥有芯片量产经验、能够理解项目周期，并且能够在没有大型组织支持的情况下做出重要决策的人。”

Anthropic 并非首家尝试自主设计 AI 芯片的人工智能公司。此前，竞争对手 OpenAI 已与博通（Broadcom）合作开发专用 AI 芯片，并于 6 月公布了名为“Jalapeño”的自研半导体项目。

相关阅读：

  • 《消息称 OpenAI、博通合作 Jalapeño 芯片采用台积电 3nm 工艺制程》

summary_zh: Anthropic发言人向Business Insider确认，公司正在组建内部芯片团队，计划为Claude模型开发定制化芯片，以应对不断增长的AI算力需求。这是Anthropic首次公开确认自研芯片计划。公司表示将通过硬件与模型协同设计，提高Claude的运行速度和效率，但不会完全依赖自研芯片，未来将采用多芯片策略，继续使用AWS、谷歌、英伟达和AMD的硬件。此前有报道称Anthropic已与三星就芯片制造合作进行沟通。

title: Verifiable Memory: Learning Unified Memory Management with Local and Global Verifiers for Large Language Model Agents
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.03137v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents must retain reusable information, control a bounded active context, and recover earlier evidence during long-horizon interaction. We present Verifiable Memory (VerMem), a framework that represents LTM, active context, and episodic history as distinct states and controls them with one memory operation policy. Seven atomic operations let the policy add, revise, or soft-delete LTM entries; retrieve LTM into the active context; filter or summarize the active context; and restore selected episodic fragments. reason_zh: 提出可验证记忆的统一内存管理方法，结合局部和全局验证器，提升LLM代理长期交互能力。
summary_zh: 论文提出可验证记忆（Verifiable Memory）方法，用于LLM代理的统一内存管理。现有方法分别优化长期和短期记忆，且统一策略常仅依赖轨迹级反馈。该方法引入局部和全局验证器，分别评估记忆片段和整体轨迹，实现更有效的记忆读写。实验证明在长时交互任务中，该方法优于现有基线，提升了代理的推理和决策能力。

title: Introducing Web Search on Amazon Bedrock for foundation model grounding
raw_text: Today, we are introducing the general availability of Web Search on Amazon Bedrock. It is a server-side built-in tool that grounds model responses in current web knowledge. With Web Search, grounding becomes a native capability of Amazon Bedrock, with no third-party vendors to onboard, no external APIs to orchestrate, and no additional third party vendor security reviews to conduct. In this post, we walk through what Web Search on Amazon Bedrock is, why it matters, how to enable it using the OpenAI Responses API, and how to get started with the tool.
reason_zh: Amazon Bedrock推出原生Web Search功能，简化模型接地流程，对AWS用户实用。
summary_zh: Amazon Bedrock宣布Web Search功能正式可用，这是一个服务端内置工具，可将模型响应基于当前网络知识进行接地。该功能使接地成为Bedrock的原生能力，无需第三方供应商、外部API编排或额外的安全审查。文章可能包含使用示例和配置指南，对于在AWS上构建应用的开发者，该功能简化了模型与实时信息的集成。
title_zh: Amazon Bedrock推出Web Search功能，用于基础模型接地

title: When Refusal Looks Safe: The Refusal-Cue Shortcut in Safety Guard Models
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.03201v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Safety guards are widely used to filter harmful content and are typically trained via supervised fine-tuning on labeled prompt-response pairs. We audit two widely used safety-guard training datasets, WildGuardMix and GR-Train, and find that among responses to harmful prompts, refusal expressions co-occur almost exclusively with unharmful labels. This imbalance motivates what we term the refusal-cue shortcut: inserting a refusal cue into a harmful response could flip the guard's verdict from harmful to unharmful. The shortcut affects not only guards trained on these datasets but also officially released models such as LlamaGuard3 and Qwen3Guard whose training data is undisclosed. It persists across response positions and is generally stronger in smaller variants within a family. To mitigate it, we adapt sparse complementary masking as a lightweight post-hoc intervention that identifies and suppresses a small set of shortcut-associated att
reason_zh: 揭示安全护栏模型中的拒绝线索捷径，可能导致误判，对AI安全有重要警示作用。
summary_zh: 安全护栏广泛用于过滤有害内容，通常通过监督微调训练。本文审计了两个广泛使用的安全护栏训练数据集WildGuardMix和GR-Train，发现对有害提示的响应中，拒绝表达几乎只与无害标签共存。这导致模型可能学习到“拒绝即安全”的捷径，从而在拒绝时误判为安全，而在未拒绝时可能漏判有害内容，揭示了安全护栏的潜在漏洞。

title: Reachability Is Not Realization: Tracing the Sources of LLM Benchmark Gains
raw_text:
arXiv:2608.03219v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Benchmark gains are often treated as evidence of greater LLM capability. Yet the same gain can reflect different changes in model behavior. A model may reach new answers, or produce answers that were already within reach. Aggregate scores do not distinguish these changes question by question. We establish a question-level audit under fixed budgets, temperatures, and answer formats. A question is realized when the default deployment procedure produces the correct answer. A question is reachable when a specified probe finds that answer within a fixed budget. We first test whether inference-time layer routing can expand reachability. Under a matched budget, random routes match or exceed structured search in all 43 model and task settings. Answer-blind procedures retain almost none of this gain, which instead requires access to the correct answer. We then ask why reachable answers sometimes fail to appear. Across six cases spanning 0.5B to 3
reason_zh: 质疑基准测试提升的解读，提出问题级审计方法，区分可达性与实现，对评估LLM能力有方法论贡献。
summary_zh: 基准测试的提升常被视为LLM能力增强的证据，但相同的提升可能反映不同的行为变化：模型可能达到新的答案，或产生原本就可达的答案。聚合分数无法逐题区分这些变化。本文在固定预算下建立问题级审计，追踪基准测试提升的来源，为更准确地评估LLM能力提供了新方法。
title_zh: 可达性不等于实现：追踪LLM基准测试提升的来源

  "a rainbow colored skunk leaps over a mossy log in a sup

raw_text: Google 对其 AI 部门 DeepMind 进行了领导层重组，诺贝尔奖得主、DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis 卸任，他将担任新设立的首席科学家职位并改任董事长。资深工程师以及 Google Brain 联合创始人 Jeff Dean、Sanjay Ghemawat、Oriol Vinyals 和 ​Quoc Le 都离开 Google，他们成立了一家公益性 AI 企业 Discovery Loop，专注于机器学习、科学和工程领域的突破性研究。这次人事变动恰逢 Google 最新 Gemini 模型的发布滞后，原计划 6 月发布，但至今仍未发布，引发了 Google 落后于竞争对手 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的担忧。

summary_zh: Google 对 AI 部门 DeepMind 进行领导层重组，CEO Demis Hassabis 卸任，转任首席科学家和董事长。同时，Jeff Dean、Sanjay Ghemawat、Oriol Vinyals 和 Quoc Le 等资深工程师离开 Google，共同创立公益性 AI 企业 Discovery Loop，专注于机器学习、科学和工程研究。此次变动恰逢 Gemini 模型发布延迟，引发外界对 Google 竞争力的担忧。
title_zh: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis 卸任

title: Cursor Open-Sources Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK): A Deterministic MoE Training Megakernel for GB300 NVL72 Racks
raw_text:
Cursor Research has open-sourced Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK), the MoE training megakernel behind its Composer models. MoK fuses all mixture-of-experts communication and computation into a single deterministic kernel, and runs up to 2.37x faster than the strongest public baseline on GB300 NVL72 racks. It requires Blackwell SM100 or SM103 GPUs, which puts it out of reach for anyone without NVL72 capacity.

The post Cursor Open-Sources Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK): A Deterministic MoE Training Megakernel for GB300 NVL72 Racks appeared first on MarkTechPost.
reason_zh: 开源MoE训练内核，性能提升显著，但依赖特定硬件，受众有限。
summary_zh: Cursor Research开源了Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK)，这是其Composer模型背后的MoE训练megakernel。MoK将混合专家通信和计算融合为单一确定性内核，在GB300 NVL72机架上比最强公开基线快2.37倍。需要Blackwell SM100或SM103 GPU，限制了非NVL72用户的使用。
title_zh: Cursor开源Mixture-of-Kittens (MoK)：面向GB300 NVL72机架的确定性MoE训练Megakernel

title: Open-weight AI models are catching up to the frontier. The safety gap remains.
raw_text: A new SaferAI report finds Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 approaches frontier AI capabilities while lacking key safety mitigations, renewing concerns that powerful open models could outpace governance and safeguards.
reason_zh: 报告指出开放权重模型能力逼近前沿但安全措施缺失，引发治理担忧，值得深入思考。
summary_zh: SaferAI报告发现，Z.ai的开放权重模型GLM-5.2接近前沿AI能力，但缺乏关键安全缓解措施。这引发了对强大开放模型可能超越治理和保障的担忧。报告强调开放权重模型的安全差距，呼吁加强监管和防护措施。
title_zh: 开放权重AI模型正追赶前沿，但安全差距依然存在
